method: Three fresh process trials per engine and transport. Current Java and JS run in alternation. Subject order reverses on alternate inputs. Structural comparison and allocation sampling run separately. Memory is Windows peak process working set at public load completion. Time is elapsed public load time. Live sampled allocations are estimates.
